CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.author_revision_media_complete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE mismatch boolean;
BEGIN
 WITH document_refs AS (
  SELECT (a->>'id')::uuid AS id,a->>'purpose' AS purpose FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(NEW.content->'attachments','[]'::jsonb)) a
  UNION
  SELECT (b #>> '{}')::uuid,'statement-image' FROM jsonb_path_query(NEW.content,'$.** ? (@.kind == "image").mediaId') b
  UNION
  SELECT (b->>'mediaId')::uuid,'solution-image' FROM authored_revision_private_part k
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(k.data->'hints','[]'::jsonb)||coalesce(k.data->'solution','[]'::jsonb)) b
   WHERE k.revision_id=NEW.id AND b->>'kind'='image'
 ), bindings AS (SELECT media_id AS id,purpose FROM author_revision_media WHERE revision_id=NEW.id)
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM document_refs EXCEPT SELECT * FROM bindings) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM bindings EXCEPT SELECT * FROM document_refs) INTO mismatch;
 IF mismatch THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Revision media bindings are incomplete'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: authored_revision_parts_match
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authored_revision_parts_match()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE mismatched boolean;
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(NEW.id::text,0));
 -- Compare canonical UUID/mode pairs in both directions; counts alone miss [A,A] vs {A,B}.
 WITH document_parts AS (
  SELECT (p->>'id')::uuid AS id, p->>'answerMode' AS answer_mode
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(NEW.content->'sections') s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(s->'parts') p
 ), relational_parts AS (
  SELECT part_id AS id, answer_mode FROM authored_revision_part WHERE revision_id=NEW.id
 )
 SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_parts)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_parts WHERE id IS NULL OR answer_mode IS NULL)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_parts GROUP BY id HAVING count(*)>1)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM document_parts EXCEPT SELECT * FROM relational_parts)
  OR EXISTS (SELECT * FROM relational_parts EXCEPT SELECT * FROM document_parts)
 INTO mismatched;
 IF mismatched THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Revision document and relational parts disagree'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

constraints.name: authored_attempt_answer_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK ((((jsonb_typeof(answer) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((answer)::text) <= 20000) AND
CASE (answer ->> 'kind'::text)
    WHEN 'numeric'::text THEN (((answer - ARRAY['kind'::text, 'value'::text, 'units'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((answer -> 'value'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND (abs(((answer ->> 'value'::text))::numeric) <= ''::numeric) AND (jsonb_typeof((answer -> 'units'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (length((answer ->> 'units'::text)) <= 80))
    WHEN 'expression'::text THEN (((answer - ARRAY['kind'::text, 'expression'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((answer -> 'expression'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((length((answer ->> 'expression'::text)) >= 1) AND (length((answer ->> 'expression'::text)) <= 180)))
    WHEN 'manual'::text THEN (((answer - ARRAY['kind'::text, 'text'::text]) = '{}'::jsonb) AND (jsonb_typeof((answer -> 'text'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (length((answer ->> 'text'::text)) <= 4000))
    ELSE false
END) IS TRUE))

constraints.name: authored_attempt_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'correct'::text) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['within-tolerance'::text, 'symbolic-equivalent'::text]))) OR ((status = 'incorrect'::text) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['outside-tolerance'::text, 'symbolic-counterexample'::text]))) OR ((status = 'needs-review'::text) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['units-unsupported'::text, 'units-mismatch'::text, 'answer-mode-unsupported'::text, 'key-unavailable'::text, 'service-unavailable'::text, 'symbolic-unsupported'::text, 'symbolic-domain'::text, 'symbolic-resource-limit'::text, 'symbolic-inconclusive'::text]))) OR ((status = 'ungraded'::text) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['invalid-input'::text, 'not-authorized'::text, 'revision-unavailable'::text, 'manual'::text])))))
